articles.title: Australia to let social media users 'opt out' of algorithm-based feeds in fresh blow to big tech
articles.description: Australia plans to give social media users the option to switch off algorithm-based feeds in proposed legislation, serving as the latest blow to tech giants.

articles.title: The U.S. is trying to reduce its reliance on China for batteries. Here's what it's up against
articles.description: The Department of Energy has given grants to small battery tech companies. But the U.S. has a few years to do what took China decades.

articles.title: Cronos executes controversial blockchain rollback to recover crypto worth $111 million
articles.description: Validators rolled back nearly two hours of blockchain history to recover user assets. But the attackers still managed to get away with $9.19 million before Cronos halted the network.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips to $78,800 as BNB and DeFi tokens buck the selloff
articles.description: Bitcoin fell 0.42% since midnight UTC to $78,874, but the CoinDesk 20 rose 0.2% and the memecoin index gained 0.41% as BNB Chain tokens rallied.

articles.title: Uzbekistan begins government bond-backed stablecoin payment pilot
articles.description: Humo Digital will test HUMO payments with more than 20 merchants under a sandbox jointly overseen by NAPP and Uzbekistan’s central bank.

articles.title: Ledger CTO urges AI bug hunter responsibility, warns against ‘attention farming’
articles.description: Ledger and Trezor said researchers have a responsibility to publish their findings if vendors fail to fix bugs within an agreed disclosure window.

articles.title: Polish Court Detains Fifth Suspect in Zondacrypto Exchange Probe
articles.description: Two chief executives of the exchange have now vanished, four years apart, leaving 1.3 million clients locked out.

articles.title: Robinhood chain to generate $160M in annual fees by 2028: Bernstein
articles.description: Growing demand for tokenized stock trading may drive the Robinhood chain’s annual fees to $160 million by 2028, predicted analysts from Bernstein.

articles.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
articles.description: South Korea’s budget office warned that stablecoin adoption could reduce banks' roles as credit intermediaries and potentially destabilize token pegs during mass redemptions.

articles.title: New Bitcoin whales spark sell-side risk as unrealized gains hit $9B
articles.description: Unrealized gains by whale speculators hit their highest levels on record last week, per data going back to 2016.

articles.title: Tracking cocoa may be just the beginning for PwC, Merck, Hashgraph provenance system
articles.description: The firms say their combination of physical authentication, digital traceability and enterprise process design has no precedent in supply chains, and cocoa is just the start.

articles.title: Pharma major Novartis falls 9% after three drug trial setbacks
articles.description: Shares of Novartis tanked on Tuesday after results from its del-desiran drug trial disappointed investors.

articles.title: TSMC, Samsung commit to ASML’s newest chipmaking tools as AI drives demand
articles.description: TSMC and Samsung will adopt ASML’s High NA EUV tools for advanced chipmaking as AI drives demand for smaller, more complex semiconductors.

articles.title: Live updates: Yen rally and rising bond yields pressure bitcoin and risk assets
articles.description: Bitcoin, gold and technology stocks fall as the yen rallies, while oil prices and government bond yields climb globally.

articles.title: Brent crude nears $100 after strikes on Saudi energy sites amid renewed Mideast hostilities
articles.description: Oil prices rose Tuesday on worries over escalating Mideast tensions after the U.S. and Iran traded strikes over the weekend.

articles.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth $27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
articles.description: Duties on U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a war of words between Washington and Ottawa continues.

articles.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks
articles.description: More than 60% of cryptocurrency platforms that lost money due to cyberattacks had undergone independent security audits, CoinGecko said.

articles.title: Cronos confirms $9.2M slipped away before Tectonic exploit rollback
articles.description: Cronos’s post-mortem put the Tectonic exploit’s affected borrowing at $120.4 million, with 7.6% transferred off-network before validators intervened.

articles.title: Global shipping authorities warn of maritime trade breakdown amid geopolitical turmoil
articles.description: Eighteen maritime bodies warned Tuesday that geopolitical tensions and a growing shadow fleet threaten to undermine international shipping and weaken trade.

articles.title: Mistral bags $24 billion valuation as Samsung leads funding for Europe's AI champion
articles.description: Mistral is betting on open-weight AI models to help it compete with players like OpenAI and Anthropic.
